notes.title: PROBLEMS SOLVED
notes.content:
[b]DESERT MAP:[/b]
Our character will no longer be able to slow down on the desert map and torches have been placed around so players can find their way around, in short, you will no longer get lost 

[b]MENU SETTINGS:[/b]
We've now added sections in the main menu and pause menu where you can adjust all the game's sound settings.
